hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the api-gateway pod will cause the entire pet/owner/visit flow to fail, as it is the entrypoint for all HTTP requests.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: The api-gateway is a single point of entry; without it, no requests can reach the backend services.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The API gateway should remain available and respond to health checks and CRUD requests.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Send health check and a sample CRUD request to the gateway; expect successful responses before and after the fault.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: The pod will be restarted automatically by Kubernetes, and the gateway should recover within a few seconds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing a 500ms network delay to the config-server will cause timeouts in all services that depend on it, leading to degraded performance or failures in the pet/owner/visit flow.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: All services depend on the config-server for configuration; increased latency can cause cascading timeouts.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: All services should be able to fetch configuration without exceeding normal response time thresholds.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Monitor response times of the API gateway and dependent services; check for timeouts or errors during the delay period.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Once the delay is removed, services should return to normal operation.
